description: Hourly, and after each CI run on main, checks that each watched daily schedule (Data Validation, Deploy backend, the nightly CI, the test read map, the proof-reuse daily) started within 3 hours of its cron, skipping occurrences from before the workflow reached main. A once-a-day target (the read map, the proof-reuse daily) also counts a run woken by main's push CI since its first working hour that day. Dispatches a missed dev-only run once (the nightly, the dev deploy), reports a missed prod run with its command for the owner and a missed report-only run as a note, and reports a nightly that never started as unknown, never green. Each missed run is handled once, recorded by a marker comment.
